```{r setup}
#| include: false
library(tidyverse)
library(gtsummary)
library(flextable)
if (!file.exists("output/analysis.RData")) source("06-models.R")
load("output/analysis.RData")
set_flextable_defaults(font.family = "Times New Roman", font.size = 10, padding = 2)
```

**Table 1. Characteristics of `r n_analytic` women in the analytic sample, Cebu Longitudinal Health and Nutrition Survey**

```{r}
t1 <- d %>%
  haven::zap_labels() %>% haven::zap_label() %>%
  transmute(
    `Age in 2005, years` = age05,
    `Body mass index in 2005, kg/m²` = mbmi05,
    `Current smoker in 2005` = factor(smoke, 0:1, c("No", "Yes")),
    `Current alcohol use in 2005` = factor(drink, 0:1, c("No", "Yes")),
    `Mother's highest grade completed` = gradema,
    `Own schooling, years` = meduc83,
    `Household wealth index in 2005` = wealth_pc_2005,
    `PCHorvath, years` = pchorvath1,
    `PCHannum, years` = pchannum,
    `PCPhenoAge, years` = pcphenoage,
    `PCGrimAge, years` = pcgrimage,
    `DunedinPACE, years of ageing per year` = dunedinpace,
    `Cognition (MMSE-P score) in 2012` = mmsesum,
    `Grip strength in 2012, kg` = grip_mean,
    `Timed Up and Go in 2012, seconds` = mean_tug,
    `HbA1c in 2012, mmol/mol` = hba1c_mmol,
    `HbA1c in 2012, %` = hba1c_avg,
    `Systolic blood pressure in 2012, mmHg` = bpsysm,
    `C-reactive protein in 2012, mg/L, median (IQR)` = crp_clean,
    `Difficulty with ≥1 IADL in 2012` = factor(iadl, 0:1, c("No", "Yes")),
    `Number of conditions in 2012` = mm_cat4
  ) %>%
  tbl_summary(
    type = list(`Age in 2005, years` ~ "continuous", `Mother's highest grade completed` ~ "continuous",
                `Own schooling, years` ~ "continuous"),
    statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{mean} ({sd})",
                     `C-reactive protein in 2012, mg/L, median (IQR)` ~ "{median} ({p25}, {p75})",
                     all_categorical() ~ "{n} ({p}%)"),
    digits = all_continuous() ~ 1,
    missing = "no"
  ) %>%
  modify_header(label ~ "Characteristic", stat_0 ~ "Mean (SD) or n (%)") %>%
  modify_footnote(everything() ~ NA)

as_flex_table(t1) %>%
  hline_top(border = officer::fp_border(width = 1), part = "all") %>%
  hline_bottom(border = officer::fp_border(width = 1), part = "all") %>%
  autofit()
```

Values are mean (standard deviation) unless stated. Epigenetic clock values are unstandardised. Statistics are unweighted. BMI, body mass index; HbA1c, glycated haemoglobin; IADL, instrumental activity of daily living; IQR, interquartile range; SD, standard deviation; MMSE-P, Mini-Mental State Examination adapted for the Philippines; PACE, pace of ageing.
